data.one_liner: Calculate string similarity and fuzzy matching scores using Levenshtein, Damerau-Levenshtein, and Jaro-Winkler.
data.what_it_does: Calculates match percentages and string distance metrics between text inputs. Supports algorithms like Levenshtein Distance, Damerau-Levenshtein Distance, and Jaro-Winkler, along with options for case-insensitive matching.
use_when: You need to detect typos or handle fuzzy search suggestions in your app.
You want to calculate string match percentages between user input and expected values.
You are comparing duplicate records or names in local data.
avoid_when: You require complex AI-powered semantic text embeddings or LLM-based understanding.
You are dealing with extremely large texts where more optimized batch processing or native vector search is required.
strengths: Provides multiple well-known distance algorithms out of the box (Levenshtein, Damerau-Levenshtein, Jaro-Winkler).
Supports case-insensitive comparisons and match percentage calculations.
weaknesses: Future updates plan for performance optimizations, phonetic algorithms (Soundex), and cosine similarity which are not yet available.
Limited to string edit distances and basic prefix/transposition metrics.
